verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform with workflow tasks and background processes, so execution-limit documentation is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack never states any CPU-time or wall-clock timeout limits for tasks, functions or services. Marketing about running agents and background processes (render-docs-5) and agents inspecting CPU metrics (render-docs-33) are adjacent claims and do not document execution limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the CPU and wall-clock execution time limits for functions so I can tell whether long-running or agentic workloads will fit
